question.text: The solubility of sulphates of alkaline earth metals in water decreases down the group because

options.text: The lattice energy of sulphates of group II decreases down the group
The lattice energy of sulphates of group II increases down the group
Both hydration and lattice energies decreases down the group
The decrease in hydration energy is more than the decreases in lattice energy

solution.text: Both lattice energy and hydration energy decreases down the group of alkaline earth sulphates but hydration energy decreases more rapidly than lattice energy.
